newsitem.title: FRANCE: French CAC-40 index sets historic high.
newsitem.headline: French CAC-40 index sets historic high.

text.p: The French blue-chip share index set an all-time high at 2,668.91 in the afternoon after a renewed rally which followed remarks by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan and was fuelled by a firm dollar, dealers said.

The market had been lower for most of the day, fearing for Greenspan's testimony due later today. But early remarks in which he said that current share levels could be justified if profit forecasts where right, eased market jitters.
The previous high was 2,658.62, reached on February 18.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 16.99 points or 0.64 percent at 2,668.68 at 1430 GMT.
